objects.description: flat robot base plate (acrylic or MDF) with mounting holes
SG90-class micro servo motor: blue plastic body, white output shaft on one end, 3-wire cable (brown, red, orange)
L-shaped bracket that holds the servo body and screws onto the chassis
small M2/M3 machine screw used to fix parts together
white plastic horn (arm or disc) that presses onto the servo's splined output shaft
plastic robot wheel with a rubber tire, fixed to the servo horn
Arduino Uno-class controller board (blue PCB, USB-B port, barrel jack, pin headers)

objects.label_es: conector del servo en la placa
objects.description: 3-pin male header on the controller board (or its shield) labeled G / V / S for one servo
short hex spacer that lifts the controller board off the chassis
4xAA battery holder with a red/black lead ending in a connector
slide switch on the battery pack or board
400-point solderless breadboard with red (+) and blue (-) power rails along the edges
5 mm LED; the long leg is the anode (+), the short leg / flat side is the cathode (-)
220 ohm through-hole resistor with color bands (red-red-brown)
male-to-male jumper wire; color identifies its role (red = signal/+, black = GND)
USB-A to USB-B cable that powers the controller board from a laptop
4-leg tactile push button that straddles the breadboard's center channel
yellow TT gear motor with two solder tabs or wires

actions.label_es: montar el servo en el soporte
actions.visual_cue: servo body seated inside the bracket with its output shaft pointing outward, away from the bracket's base

actions.label_es: montar el servo al revés
actions.visual_cue: servo seated in the bracket with its output shaft pointing inward, toward the bracket's base or the chassis

actions.label_es: atornillar el servo al soporte
actions.visual_cue: screwdriver driving screws through the servo's mounting tabs into the bracket; both tabs end with a screw head

actions.label_es: atornillar el soporte al chasis
actions.visual_cue: bracket held flat on the chassis plate and screwed through the plate's holes; bracket no longer moves

actions.label_es: poner el brazo en el eje del servo
actions.visual_cue: white horn pressed down onto the servo's output shaft until it sits flush

actions.label_es: atornillar la rueda al brazo
actions.visual_cue: wheel held against the horn and screwed through its center; wheel turns together with the shaft

actions.label_es: encajar la rueda directo en el eje
actions.visual_cue: wheel pushed straight onto the bare servo shaft with no horn in between

actions.label_es: montar la placa sobre los separadores
actions.visual_cue: controller board placed on hex standoffs on the chassis and screwed down at its corner holes

actions.label_es: conectar el cable del servo a la placa
actions.visual_cue: servo's 3-wire connector pushed onto the G/V/S header with the brown wire on G and the orange wire on S

actions.label_es: conectar el cable del servo al revés
actions.visual_cue: servo connector on the G/V/S header turned around: the orange wire sits on G and the brown wire on S

actions.label_es: conectar el portapilas a la placa
actions.visual_cue: battery pack lead plugged into the board's barrel jack or power terminal; the board's power LED lights up

actions.label_es: encender el interruptor
actions.visual_cue: slide switch moved to ON; a power LED turns on

actions.label_es: poner el LED en la protoboard
actions.visual_cue: LED standing in the breadboard with its two legs in two different columns, long leg on the side where the signal wire will go

actions.label_es: poner el LED al revés
actions.visual_cue: LED in the breadboard with the short leg (flat side) in the column of the signal wire and the long leg toward the resistor / ground

actions.label_es: poner la resistencia en la protoboard
actions.visual_cue: resistor bridging from the LED's short-leg column to the blue (-) rail

actions.label_es: poner el botón en la protoboard
actions.visual_cue: push button straddling the center channel with two legs on each side

actions.label_es: conectar el cable del pin 13 al LED
actions.visual_cue: red jumper wire from the board's digital pin 13 to the breadboard column of the LED's long leg

actions.label_es: conectar el cable a otro pin
actions.visual_cue: the red jumper wire's board end sits in a digital pin other than 13 (e.g. 12 or GND)

actions.label_es: conectar GND al riel azul
actions.visual_cue: black jumper wire from a GND pin on the board to the breadboard's blue (-) rail

actions.label_es: conectar los cables del motor
actions.visual_cue: the motor's two wires inserted into the motor driver's output terminals

actions.label_es: conectar el USB a la placa
actions.visual_cue: USB cable plugged into the board's USB-B port; the board's power LED lights up
